title: Poker
description: Full Texas Hold'em Poker - Requires EmeraldBank [ALPHA]
body:
# Poker - Texas Hold'em

> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION** - This plugin is in development. Bugs may exist.

## ⚠️ Required: EmeraldBank

**[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) is REQUIRED!**

### Installation
1. Download [EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2)
2. Download Poker
3. Put both in plugins folder
4. Restart server

---

## Features

- **Full Texas Hold'em** - Preflop, Flop, Turn, River, Showdown
- **All Actions** - Check, Call, Raise, Fold
- **Hand Evaluation** - Accurate poker hand ranking
- **Sign Display** - Community cards shown on 5 signs
- **Scoreboard** - Real-time game status
- **Persistent Settings** - Saved to signs.yml

## Hand Rankings

| Rank | Hand |
|------|------|
| 1 | Royal Straight Flush |
| 2 | Straight Flush |
| 3 | Four of a Kind |
| 4 | Full House |
| 5 | Flush |
| 6 | Straight |
| 7 | Three of a Kind |
| 8 | Two Pair |
| 9 | One Pair |
| 10 | High Card |

## Commands

### Player
- `/poker join` - Join game
- `/poker leave` - Leave game
- `/poker money` - Check pot

### Admin
- `/poker bet <amount>` - Set SB (BB = 2x)
- `/poker raisemoney <amount>` - Set raise limit
- `/poker sign1~5` - Set sign positions
- `/poker start` - Start game
- `/poker stop` - Force stop

**Alias:** `/pk`

## Setup

1. Place 5 signs
2. Look at each sign → `/poker sign1` through `/poker sign5`
3. `/poker bet 10` (SB=10, BB=20)
4. Players: `/poker join`
5. Admin: `/poker start`

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `poker.admin` | All admin | op |
| `poker.admin.setup` | Setup | op |
| `poker.admin.control` | Start/stop | op |
| `poker.player.info` | Check pot | true |

## Requirements

- **[EmeraldBank](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emeraldbank2) (REQUIRED)**
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---
